meta.name: Midnight Diner: Tokyo Stories
meta.description:
In an otherwise mundane diner open from midnight to 7 a.m., there is no menu – but the chef cooks anything his customers want. Each episode is about different a different customer, as they find simple yet profound connections with one another based on their shared love of a particular dish.

Rated 15 · Returning Series · First aired 21 Oct 2016 · Japan · Language: Japanese · 24 min
Studio: MBS, AMUSE, Geek Sight · Network: MBS, TBS

Not complete. On your server: S1 9/10 (missing E4) | S2 10/10 | S3 not on server

On your server — Audio: Korean

videos.title: Tan Men
videos.overview: A specially prepared bowl of tanmen noodles leads a radio announcer to discover a secret about a beloved television show from his youth.

videos.title: Corn Dog
videos.overview: A childish fight over a fish-sausage corn dog leads to a schism between an Asakusa comedian and his now-famous former assistant.

videos.title: Tonteki
videos.overview: An office worker who loves pork steaks knits sweaters for the men she adores, but her affections – and handiwork – are not always appreciated.

videos.title: Egg Tofu
videos.overview: A lonely little boy with only a gambler to take care of him hopes to make a connection with a bar girl over a mutual appreciation for egg tofu.

videos.title: Umeboshi and Plum Wine
videos.overview: Upon finishing the last of his late mother's pickled plums, a man suddenly wonders what will become of his erotica after he passes away.

videos.title: Hot Pot for One
videos.overview: A diner regular reunites with an old classmate who, despite a good upbringing, now works a menial job to support her troublesome nephew.

videos.title: Sautéed Yam
videos.overview: A dish of sauteed Chinese yam rekindles the connection between a young wife and her former lover, with whom she shares a hidden professional past.

videos.title: Ham Cutlet
videos.overview: A breaded ham cutlet brings back an elderly lawyer's memories of playing the board game Othello with his long-lost younger brother.

videos.title: New Year's Eve Noodles, Again
videos.overview: As December comes to a close and the regulars gather at the diner, the Master takes a look back at his memories of the year.

videos.title: Chicken Fried Rice
videos.overview: Game designer Akai grew up in an orphanage. He finds solace in a chicken rice dish that also holds the key to reconnecting with his birth mother.

videos.title: Fried Chicken Breast with Cheese
videos.overview: Writer Yada and hostess Hikaru bond over their love of horoscopes and chicken cheese cutlet. Secretly, Yada tries to use the horoscopes to woo her.

videos.title: Plum Rice Ball
videos.overview: A retired old schoolteacher reconnects with his former student: diner regular Marilyn. Awkwardly, her high school nemesis also shows up.

videos.title: Fried Chicken Wings
videos.overview: In her mid-30s, Chizuru worries her modeling career is ending. An encounter with a high-powered fan gives her a chance to evaluate her priorities.

videos.title: Yakisoba Dog
videos.overview: Businessman Kotani is jubilant at his high school baseball team's success. His joy stirs up memories of his former best friend, the coach of the team.

videos.title: Salmon and Mushrooms
videos.overview: The Ueharas run a barbershop together. They seem happy, but when his wife goes on a trip, a beautiful kimono instructor catches Mr. Uehara's eye.

videos.title: Kitsune Udon
videos.overview: Two aspiring voice actresses stop by for lucky bowls of kitsune udon, but six months later, only one of them seems to have had any luck.

videos.title: Curry Ramen
videos.overview: A pachinko parlor employee and the middle school classmate he idolized seem to reconnect over curry ramen, but appearances can be deceiving.

videos.title: Sweet Rolled Omelet
videos.overview: A Mr. Lee shows up nightly, ordering rolled omelets every time. He turns out to be a film director fleeing from his own set and his father's legacy.

videos.title: Crab and Toshikoshi Soba
videos.overview: It's never too late for a fresh start. One year ends and another begins as familiar faces gather to celebrate New Year’s Eve at the Midnight Diner.
